verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution, powered by OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, gives AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them. It automatically prompts the LLM with the stack trace, environment and affected code, and supports collaborative chat with results posted back as comments on the error. Missing for 10: no evidence that breadcrumbs or related commits/deployments feed the AI analysis, setup requires bringing your own OpenAI API key, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.
